questions.question: Q1. What is the primary purpose of an AI-based Eco-Driving system in an EV?

answers.b: To optimize energy efficiency and extend driving range by advising smooth driving behavior

explanations.a: Eco-driving focuses on efficiency, not maximizing top speed.
explanations.b: Correct. Eco-driving systems calculate optimal speed and acceleration profiles to maximize range.
explanations.c: Safety limits are maintained by the BMS and motor controller.
explanations.d: Eco-driving provides recommendations or adaptive velocity control, not direct steering takeover.

questions.question: Q2. Which driving pattern consumes the highest amount of battery energy per kilometer?

answers.c: Aggressive acceleration and hard braking in heavy traffic
answers.d: Low-speed steady driving on flat terrain

explanations.a: Cruising at constant speed is relatively efficient compared to rapid acceleration.
explanations.b: Coasting maximizes energy recovery and minimizes energy waste.
explanations.c: Correct. Frequent hard accelerations spike peak power demand and waste kinetic energy as heat.
explanations.d: Steady low-speed driving consumes minimal power per kilometer.

questions.question: Q3. How does predictive velocity profiling improve EV range?

answers.a: By continuously running the cooling pump at 100% capacity
answers.b: By anticipating traffic conditions and terrain elevation to smooth out speed changes
answers.c: By disabling regenerative braking during downhill descents
answers.d: By disconnecting the battery during acceleration

explanations.a: Running cooling pumps unnecessarily wastes auxiliary electrical energy.
explanations.b: Correct. Predictive algorithms use terrain and traffic data to minimize unnecessary acceleration and maximize regen.
explanations.c: Regen during descents captures gravity-assisted energy.
explanations.d: Disconnecting the battery would cut power to the motor completely.

questions.question: Q4. What parameter does the Eco-Score index evaluate in the simulation UI?

answers.b: Smoothness of acceleration, braking efficiency, and adherence to eco-velocity targets

explanations.a: Tire wear is a long-term mechanical metric, not the eco-score driver feedback metric.
explanations.b: Correct. The Eco-Score rewards smooth throttle inputs, high regen ratios, and steady speeds.
explanations.c: Ambient temperature affects battery efficiency but is an environmental factor.
explanations.d: Cable resistance is a hardware characteristic.

questions.question: Q5. What strategy yields the optimal energy recovery ratio during deceleration?

answers.a: Slamming on the mechanical friction brake pedal instantly
answers.b: Applying gradual, gentle braking within the MGU regenerative force limit
answers.c: Accelerating hard right before coming to a stop
answers.d: Shifting into neutral at high speeds

explanations.a: Hard braking forces the system to use friction brakes, wasting kinetic energy as heat.
explanations.b: Correct. Gentle braking keeps deceleration force within the motor regen limit, maximizing energy capture.
explanations.c: Accelerating before stopping wastes additional battery energy.
explanations.d: Shifting to neutral disengages regenerative harvesting.
